key_findings: rTMS alleviated thermal hyperalgesia and mechanical allodynia in sciatic nerve ligation rats and reduced Iba-1, TRPV1, CD86 and MMP9 in spinal cord.
In sciatic nerve, rTMS lowered Iba-1, TRPV1, S100 and GFAP and improved myelin integrity and muscle atrophy.
